rationale: Symphony Creative Studio brings deep expertise in generative AI and creator tooling from ByteDance's ad tech platform, while Sharon's background in production-ready AI agent infrastructure and developer tooling (PHP/TYPO3 ecosystem) offers complementary technical depth.
